newsitem.title: USA: Texaco selects BBDO for product advertising.
newsitem.headline: Texaco selects BBDO for product advertising.

text.p: Texaco Inc. said Monday it plans to move its U.S. product advertising from Bates Worldwide, a unit of Cordiant PLC, to BBDO Worldwide, which already handles the company's corporate image account.
Billings were estimated at between $30 million and $40 million.

BBDO, part of the Omnicom Group, is expected to take over product advertising by January 1998, according to Texaco spokeswoman Cynthia Michener, who confirmed reports of Texaco's decision in Advertising Age magazine and Monday's New York Times.

"Texaco has enjoyed a long relationship with Bates and is proud of the work Bates has done to strengthen the Texaco brand ...," she said in a statement. "However, this move is an effort to consolidate Texaco's product and corporate image advertising activities under one agency."
Texaco, which had been the target of a widely publicized racial discrimination lawsuit that was settled, selected BBDO Worldwide in December to handle its corporate image work.
Michener said a product advertising campaign developed this year by Bates would continue through August.
